// Review check fixture. Plain text: never imported, built or deployed.
import { publishCount } from '../lib/count-floor';

interface Env { DB: D1Database }

export async function eventAttendance(eventId: string, env: Env): Promise<Response> {
  const row = await env.DB.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scans WHERE event_id = ?1')
    .bind(eventId)
    .first<{ n: number }>();
  const total = publishCount(row?.n ?? 0);
  return Response.json({ eventId, checkIns: total });
}
